text: In Finnish Lapland, an American and British drilling team [blasts open Korvatunturi, which their leader believes is an ancient burial mound|wrong|disturbing the dead]. Young Pietari, who believes Santa Claus is real and punishes bad children, watches as reindeer turn up slaughtered, heaters and potato sacks disappear from houses, and the [local children go missing one by one|who_suffers|young children]. On Christmas Eve, his father's wolf trap catches a skinny, naked old man, and the hunters [cage him to sell to the company|images|ropes, cages and executions], unaware of what waits in the ice.
